$comment: Relevance labels for the RAG-03 fixture, keyed by document and section rather than by chunk id.
A responder's question is answered by a section of a runbook or a postmortem, and a label keyed
on it survives an edit elsewhere in the document. Resolved to chunk identifiers after ingestion;
a label naming a section that no longer exists fails the evaluation rather than scoring zero.
Grades as in docs/corpus-procedure.md. Labelled by the author of the fixture.
i-006 is i-005's question asked by a principal who may not read the security postmortem. It has
no relevant section they can see, and is reported as unscorable rather than folded into recall.
